source: Dalton–Haldar 1872 Juanga column, printed comparative table pp.235, 237–240
method: Independent visual second reading of all accepted Juanga column cells against original scan and same-line English headings, using rendered 350-dpi source pages/crops; blank and held cells not reclassified.

corrections.reason: Printed final acute visible in Juanga cell; coordinating editor corrected both printed and reviewed fields.

exclusions: Five source-uncertain held cells and 150 printed Juanga ellipses remain accounted in comparative-extension.tsv; no lexical substitution from the separate pp.241–242 list.
